skill.summary: Your personal AI assistant platform — multi-agent orchestration, task management, and autonomous workflow execution.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 1Person Pro — your personal AI assistant platform.

- Orchestrate multiple specialized agents for complex tasks
- Manage, track, and delegate tasks with autonomous execution
- Build reusable automated workflows
- Enjoy persistent memory across sessions
- Requires setup of the ONEPERSON_API_KEY environment variable
